actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.sendMessage.description: Send a message to a chatbot session
actions.sendMessage.props.chatbot_uuid.d: The UUID of the chatbot to send the message to
actions.sendMessage.props.query.descript: The message to send to the chatbot
actions.sendMessage.props.session_uuid.d: The UUID of the session to send the message to
auth.description:
To get your API Key:

1. Go to [Chatsistant platform](https://app.chatsistant.com/)
2. Sign up or log in to your account
3. Click on the "Account" menu in the navigation bar
4. Navigate to the "API Keys" section
5. Click "Generate new key"
6. Enter a description for your key and click "Generate"
7. Copy and save your API key securely
triggers.formSubmission.description: Triggered when a form is submitted
triggers.formSubmission.props.markdown.d:
## Chatsistant Webhook Setup
            To use this trigger, you need to manually set up a webhook in your Chatsistant account:

            1. Login to your Chatsistant account.
            2. Navigate to **Customizations** tab on the left navigation menu.
            3. Scroll down to **Webhook** and click to expand it.
            4. Select the **Form Submission** event and specify the following URL:
            ```text
            {{webhookUrl}}
            ```
            5. Click Save to register the webhook.
